name: HyperBit SRLs
notes:
**HyperBit** is an independent ISP and Managed Security Service Provider based in **South Tyrol / Trentino, Italy**. We provide business and residential connectivity (FTTH, FTTC, FWA), VoIP/SIP, managed IT and cybersecurity services to customers across Northern Italy.

Our network is built on open standards and automated end to end

---

### Network footprint
- **Core PoP:** Seeweb Caldera, Milan (IT)
- **Traffic profile:** mostly inbound (eyeball / enterprise)

---

### Peering policy
- **Open peering**: we peer with anyone at any IXP where we are both present.
- We connect to all **route servers** available at our IXPs.
- **Private interconnects (PNI)** are available at Seeweb Caldera, Milan, for networks with significant traffic towards us.
- We expect **both IPv4 and IPv6** sessions wherever possible.
- No minimum traffic requirement for IXP peering.

**To request peering, please visit https://peering.hyperbit.it**

---

### Technical requirements
- Please announce only your own prefixes and those of your customers, consistent with your IRR data.
- Please set a reasonable **max-prefix** limit based on our PeeringDB values.
- Please do not point a default route towards us, and do not carry third-party traffic through our peering ports.
- We are happy to configure BGP MD5 authentication on request.

---

### Routing security
- We **drop RPKI-invalid** routes (ROV) on all eBGP sessions.
- We filter peers on their registered **IRR as-set**.
- All our prefixes are covered by **ROAs** and registered in the RIPE IRR.
- AS-SET: **RIPE::AS208437:AS-HYPERBIT**

---

Our NOC operates in **CET/CEST** and speaks Italian, English and German.

*HyperBit — We connect the world!*
